scenario: WIBTA if I refused to translate medical jargon for my family anymore? | I (25f) am a first gen college student, and am almost finished with my nursing degree. My family is all insanely supportive and proud of me, and generously have all come together to cover my expenses as far as rent/food/pocket money/car/insurance etc, so I can be completely focused on school. I’m so increasingly thankful for them all but they’re starting to get on my nerves. Since I’m studying to be a nurse, I can understand and break down medical jargon to my family in a way that they can understand.
